custom_samsung_not_alive: The instance is not running - start it to use the remote
custom_samsung_hint: Click the remote and use the arrow keys, Enter, Backspace, + and - of the keyboard
custom_samsung_setup_find_text: Switch the TV on. The search finds Samsung TVs in the same network.
custom_samsung_setup_none_found: No TV found. Is it switched on and in the same network? You can also enter its IP address.
custom_samsung_setup_pair_text: ioBroker has to be allowed once on "%s". After that the TV remembers it.
custom_samsung_setup_pair_hint_on: Sit in front of the TV - it must be switched on.
custom_samsung_setup_pair_hint_allow: The TV asks whether ioBroker may connect - choose "Allow" with the remote control within 30 seconds.
custom_samsung_setup_pair_waiting: Waiting for "Allow" on the TV ... %s s
custom_samsung_setup_wol: Switch the TV on with Wake-on-LAN
custom_samsung_setup_wol_hint: On the TV: Settings › General › Network › Expert settings › "Power on with mobile" must be on.
custom_samsung_setup_wol_wlan: Over WLAN this works from the network standby; tested with a The Frame 2022.
custom_samsung_setup_test_text: Send a test key with the new data before saving: the TV shows its info banner.
custom_samsung_setup_test_sent: The key reached the TV. Do you see the info banner? Then everything works.
custom_samsung_setup_configured: The TV at %s is set up.
custom_samsung_setup_not_alive: The instance is not running. Start it, then the assistant can search for and pair with the TV.
custom_samsung_setup_err_denied: The TV denied the connection. On the TV: Settings › General › External device manager › Device connection manager › Device list - allow or delete "ioBroker", then try again.
custom_samsung_setup_err_timeout: Nobody allowed the connection on the TV in time. Sit in front of the TV and try again.
custom_samsung_setup_err_unreachable: The TV does not answer. Is it switched on and in the same network?
custom_samsung_setup_err_no_token: The TV accepted the connection but sent no token. Try again; if it keeps happening, delete "ioBroker" in the device connection manager of the TV.
